The one row set both the C# reference and cultnet-rs build their parity vectors from. schemaId is each schema's real SHA-256 content-hash id, exactly as GameCult.Caching.CultDocumentRegistry computes it for the fixture's C# document types (leaf_a=ParityLeafA, leaf_b=ParityLeafB, citer=ParityCiter, tests/GameCult.Networking.Tests/SelectionParityVectorTests.cs) - CultCache.cs's Sha256(semanticFingerprint), which carries no '.vN' suffix of its own; the version is folded into the hash, never appended as text. //aliases: Two DIFFERENT alias forms, because the two runtimes' schema-alias matchers key off different attributes of a descriptor and there is no candidate string that resolves through both (this cut's confirmed report finding): nameAlias is <SchemaName>.v9, which CultNetSchemaAliasMatching.Matches(candidate, CultDocumentDescriptor) resolves by stripping the trailing .vN and comparing to descriptor.SchemaName (C#'s only real alias call sites all use this descriptor overload - src/GameCult.Networking/CultNetDatabase.cs:74-87 - never the schemaId-vs-schemaId overload). hashAlias is <schemaId>.v1, which cultnet_rs::selection::schema_alias::matches resolves by stripping the trailing .vN from EITHER side and comparing the remaining hash text - a mechanism C#'s production code path never invokes for `schemas`/`cites.target.schemaId` at all.

rows.//: R-D: 2233759.25 is exactly representable as an f32 and sits on a round-to-even tie between two shortest-form spellings; its exact canonical decimal is 2233759.25 either way. kind=tie so no weapon/armor/shared case can sweep it up.
R-C: BMP private-use key (U+E000), same ordinal as the astral row below so the tiebreak - not the ordinal - decides order. kind=unicode, mass=0 so no unfiltered or mass>1 case reaches these.
R-C: astral key (U+1F602, encoded as a surrogate pair whose high half 0xD83D is less than 0xE000 - a UTF-16 code-unit compare sorts this first; code-point order sorts it after the BMP row above).
